handoff_schema.transport: append-only joint_flow_events.handoff_created; receiving stage verifies digest and binding before model invocation

stages.activation: new authenticated flow with exact non-sensitive request, active workspace membership and explicit OpenAI consent
stages.continuation: candidate and governed verdict pass; activation_recommendation mediator

stages.activation: verified eligible Communicator handoff and persisted child run
stages.continuation: candidate and governed verdict pass; all three packet arrays nonempty

stages.activation: verified eligible Mediator handoff, explicit artifact request and complete constraints packet
stages.continuation: candidate and governed verdict pass; artifact content and acknowledgements persisted before Refiner

stages.activation: verified eligible Drafter handoff and persisted artifact identity and lineage
stages.continuation: verification_verdict pass and candidate/governed verdict pass
resources: artifact and constraints in the input

stages.activation: verified eligible Refiner PASS handoff and persisted artifact identity
stages.continuation: precondition_verdict pass, artifact identity matches and commit_authority_exercised false

skip_predicate: all downstream pending stages become skipped after terminal fail, escalate, invalid handoff or missing precondition; skipped means never invoked
fail_closed_predicate: invalid contract, unverified handoff, missing persistence, model/NEXUS failure or non-pass stage outcome blocks downstream activation without retry

nexus_boundary.execution: each child uses live_governed_evaluation_v0 pinned Alpha/Delta/Omega adapter

evidence_requirements: child run and model response identity
NEXUS result digest and kernel pin
lineage_requirements: Drafter artifact identity is sha256 of candidate content
Refiner verifies the same artifact identity
Origin repeats the pass-qualified artifact identity

knowledge_boundary.inputs: request, scenario context, operational contract, and verified prior-stage handoffs only
knowledge_boundary.missing_policy_or_forbidden_pattern_refe: escalate or stop; do not imply hidden retrieval
